items.title: Wisdom of Nym: Reactions to Final Fantasy XIV’s second fan festival
"We'd Probably Have To Release Them In 4 Or 5 Instalments" - Final Fantasy XIV's Director On Why More Remakes Haven't Materialised
items.summary: "Look at Final Fantasy VI; it’s such an incredibly huge game."
items.content:
"Look at Final Fantasy VI; it’s such an incredibly huge game."

The Final Fantasy 14 director Naoki Yoshida suggested that if remakes of Final Fantasy VI, VIII, and IX were to happen, they would potentially be a much larger undertaking than the current Final Fantasy VII Remake Trilogy, requiring four or five instalments (h/t: Genki / VGC ).

Yoshida made the comments during Naoki's Room, an on-stage conversation at the Final Fantasy 14 Fan Festival in Berlin , where he was joined by the Final Fantasy VII Remake Trilogy director, Naoki Hamaguchi, and a pair of translators, with the conversation turning to remakes after the pair were asked for their favourite games.

Through one of the translators, Hamaguchi said this was a discussion he had partaken in with several journalists over the years, regularly answering Final Fantasy VI as one of the most important games he played, but suggested that every time he gave that answer it ends up being misinterpreted as proof he's working on a remake of his own.

"I’ve given this answer to a lot of media interviews," said Hamaguchi. "But Final Fantasy VI is the reason that I wanted to work in games, so that always has a special place in my heart. But every time I give that answer to a journalist or someone, the next day there is an article online saying ‘Hamaguchi will be remaking Final Fantasy VI,’ so I’ll say, ‘No, I am not.’"

It was at this point that Yoshida jumped in and attempted to explain why Square Enix hasn't yet gotten around to remaking these titles, saying that one of the major reasons is the sheer scope of these games and the amount of effort it would take to do it properly.

"Of course, I understand the feelings of the players," Yoshida said. "But you gotta think about it. Look at Final Fantasy VI; it’s such an incredibly huge game. The scale is just immense. And the same applies for other titles like Final Fantasy VIII and Final Fantasy IX. So of course now, since you are working on the Final Fantasy VII series. I do get that people would be asking for remakes of other titles. But if we did remake those other titles, we’d probably end up having to release them in 4 instalments or maybe even 5 instalments.”

In response, Hamaguchi used it as an opportunity to praise the Final Fantasy VII Remake team, crediting them with being a special group due to their loyalty and dedication over the last decade: "I really think, having worked on the Final Fantasy VII Remake series, that I am truly blessed with a wonderful team. They’ve stuck with me for over 10 years, working on three separate games that are remakes of a single game, and there are not many who would do that. We're not quite at the finish line yet. Revelations isn't out, but we're almost there, and I'm so, so grateful to them that we've been able to make it this far."

If you want to watch back the full section, we've included a timestamp here , marking the beginning of this discussion.

The project is now in the works at the French animation studio Eurovisual

items.title: Talking Evercold, Bastion, and the future of Final Fantasy XIV at Fan Fest Berlin
items.summary: It's the end of Fan Fest 2026 Berlin. It has been a long day, the beautiful piano concert still slightly ringing in my ears. But I have one more thing to
items.content:
It’s the end of Fan Fest 2026 Berlin. It has been a long day, the beautiful piano concert still slightly ringing in my ears. But I have one more thing to do before I can climb into my moderately comfortable hotel bed. Gathered with the other press in the air-conditioned conference room, Naoki Yoshida answered some of the burning questions of the room about Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold and the future of the game.

Below is all the juicy – and some not so juicy – information from the press conference, with questions submitted by multiple media outlets. Please be aware that this was translated from Japanese in real time and therefore has been edited for cohesion and brevity.

Q1: What was the biggest challenge in establishing the visual identity of Evercold so that it immediately felt distinct from Ishgard or Garlemald despite also being a frozen setting?

With Evercold, due to the theme that we have, you may be thinking of imagery of ice and snow. But for Evercold, we’re not really developing any kind of snowy or icy areas. This is something that applies not only to Evercold, but whenever we approach developing a new expansion. When we’re thinking about developing new areas, we want to create something which all our players have never seen before. Something that they wouldn’t even imagine. We want to think up areas which we haven’t really experienced or seen before either.

So, when we go through that process, we really want to have a good think about what kind of scenery there is, what kind of culture there is, what kind of daily lives we can experience, which is really refreshing and something completely new. Then after we’ve defined that direction, we go about creating the artwork.This time around, we’ve been looking to Norse mythology and Nordic culture as a source of inspiration. We’ve looked around what sort of old mythology there is that we can draw from and we’ve melded that with a fantasy aesthetic. So, I hope you can look forward to it.

One final point regarding having some sense of distinction from Garlemald itself. I think Garlemald you would associate with quite icy, black, dark scenery. Whenever we do create new areas, we do sometimes end up with a similar aesthetic. There are times when we create a new area and we think, yeah, it does look a bit like Garlemald, so maybe we need to look in a slightly different direction.

Q2: Do you have any plans to modernise the housing system in Final Fantasy XIV going forward?

I get the feeling what you really want to ask is, “Well, WOW has come up with this amazing housing system, how about FFXIV?”. I think you would know that we have immense respect for the World of Warcraft team. We saw that when the World of Warcraft team announced their expansion and this new housing system, they said specifically that they looked to FFXIV and incorporated things because they wanted to surpass us. I think that is very much a great honour for us to hear. Of course, I had a hands-on with the WOW housing system myself and I really do appreciate that it’s amazing. We always like taking on new challenges. So, when I tried WOW’s housing system, I thought that it really is amazing and it’s been a good source of research for me. I can’t say exactly when it will happen, but what I can say is that for the Patch 8X series, we are planning two very big overhauls for housing.

The first one of those updates is around the UI. I do appreciate that right now the UI in FFXIV is quite technical and it’s not very accessible. So, what we want to do is to have a major overhaul of that UI so that it is more accessible for casual players and so that they can easily create elaborate housing layouts. As for the second major update that we have planned, unfortunately I’m not able to provide any details right now, but I think probably you will be much happier to hear what it is compared to the UI update.

It’s currently in the planning process right now on our end. There is a higher chance that it will get released earlier than the UI update, but once we have a greater visibility into exactly when we can provide this update, we will announce further details. Once again, I can’t actually say any specific details right now, but I think once we are able to share those details, it’s probably the number one thing on the list that a lot of people are requesting.

Q3: Was the Bastion Job inspired by any Jobs from the older Final Fantasy games?

This is not just limited to Bastion, but whenever we want to implement a new Job in XIV, the most important thing for us is that we are consciously paying attention to making sure that the job is engaging and fun to play. So, when we thought about which next new Job to put in XIV, we thought, “okay, we need to put in a new Tank Job” and we decided on the Bastion. It was not related to the previous Final Fantasy titles because, more than anything, we wanted to ensure that whatever direction we did go in would be engaging and fun for the players.

Q4: I understand more detailed information about Bastion will be revealed in the future, but can you explain its overall concept and how it differs from the other Tanks? In particular, I’m intrigued by the inclusion of ranged attacks as part of its tool kit.

Regarding the ranged attacks in its toolkit, I think you could also look to Paladin, which also has ranged attacks. But I think maybe one of the benefits of Bastion is that it can shoot. It has a good combination of close range attacks and then attacks which can be done from afar; so, with those shooting abilities, it can be useful in certain encounter situations.

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV Launches August 4 for Switch 2, Evercold Expansion in January 2027 - News
items.summary: Square Enix announced Final Fantasy XIV will launch for the Nintendo Switch 2 on August 4 and the Evercold expansion [...]
items.content:
Square Enix announced Final Fantasy XIV will launch for the Nintendo Switch 2 on August 4 and the Evercold expansion will launch in January 2027.

Pre-orders for the Switch 2 versions are now open. It will require a separate monthly subscription from the other version, however, it will not require a Nintendo Switch Online subscription. Users subscribed to other platforms can get a 50 percent discount on the subscription price on the Switch 2.

View the Evercold expansion extended trailer below:

Square Enix today revealed brand-new information about Evercold , the sixth expansion for its critically acclaimed MMORPG Final Fantasy XIV Online , set to launch in January 2027 alongside new playable content, a Final Fantasy VII Remake trilogy crossover raid series, the Nintendo Switch 2 version release date, and more.

An extended teaser trailer for Evercold was also revealed, providing a glimpse into the world of the Fourth and the adventures that await the Warrior of Light in the start of the Goddless Realms Saga story arc.

During the Fan Festival 2026 in Berlin keynote address, Producer and Director Naoki Yoshida revealed the first new job coming to Evercold : Bastion—a main tank that wields a pair of greatshields known as skyltborg—and unveiled a trailer showcasing the new job in action.

Details were also shared on several new features coming to Evercold , including changes to the narrative structure that will be implemented for the main scenario, field, and game system, allowing players more freedom to choose what area they complete first between various paths in the main scenario. Through Auto Content Balancing, difficulty scaling and enemy levels will adjust to the appropriate player level as they play through dungeons in their chosen order. Additionally, a first look was provided for Character Action Skins, a feature that lets players assign alternate animations to personalize existing General actions, such as Teleport and Warp, with support for additional skins such as job actions arriving in future updates. Character customization will also be expanded so players have more ways to make their character stand out, including a greater range of color options with the new color picker, the ability to fine-tune features such as eyes and lips, new elements such as eye shadow, and more.

Following the reveal of the Evangelion “Ghosts of Desire” alliance raid series in April, Yoshida unveiled a new teaser trailer and announced that acclaimed director and animator Mahiro Maeda will join the project as a special guest artist and designer. Throughout his career, Maeda has contributed to numerous acclaimed projects, including Mad Max: Fury Road (2015) as a concept artist and designer, and Evangelion:3.0 +1.0 Thrice Upon a Time (2021), where he served as director, concept art director, storyboard artist, art setting designer and key animator.

Joined on stage by Final Fantasy VII Remake series Director Naoki Hamaguchi, Yoshida also revealed “Beyond the Lifestream,” a new Final Fantasy VII -themed eight-player raid series that players will challenge in Evercold . Both development teams are working closely together to create an exciting new raid experience for players.

Further, Final Fantasy XIV will launch on Nintendo Switch 2 on Tuesday, August 4, 2026, with pre-orders starting today on Nintendo eShop. To ensure server stability, there will be an approximately one-month free subscription period on Nintendo Switch 2. Whether beginning with the Free Trial, starting their adventure with the Starter Edition, or diving into the full story and experience with the Complete Edition, more players than ever before will soon be able to join together in the vast world of Final Fantasy XIV .

An outline of the content reveals from the keynote address can be found below:

Finally, Yoshida revealed the Evercold Collector’s Bundle, which includes a collection of physical items: the Evercold Special Art Box, Expertly Crafted Reaper Figure, Ethos Metal Keychain, Köttr Mini Plush, and Tapestry of the Fourth. Also included is the digital Collector’s Edition, featuring three in-game items: the Crystal Skyltborg bastion weapon, Vallhallar Odin mount, and Entreat Crystal emote. More information regarding availability and pre-orders will be announced in the future.

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV MMORPG Reveals Bastion Job, New Areas for 'Evercold' Expansion in Videos
items.summary: Guest Creator Mahiro Maeda joins Neon Genesis Evangelion "Ghosts of Desire" collaboration; game
items.content:
The livestream for the Final Fantasy XIV Fan Festival 2026 in Berlin revealed on Saturday videos for the "Evercold" expansion for Square Enix 's Final Fantasy XIV MMORPG. The videos revealed the new Bastion Job in the expansion as well as new areas available in the expansion.

Additionally, the event announced the game's previously revealed Nintendo Switch 2 version will launch on August 4.

Square Enix will reveal the second new job for the expansion at the Fan Festival event at Makuhari Messe in Tokyo on October 31-November 1.

Square Enix also revealed in the event's keynote speech that the game's collaboration with the Neon Genesis Evangelion series titled "Ghosts of Desire" is bringing on guest creator Mahiro Maeda ( Evangelion: 3.0+1.0: Thrice Upon A Time , Evangelion: 3.0 You Can (Not) Redo ).

Additionally the event revealed a new collaboration with Final Fantasy VII Remake , with a new eight-player raid series that will be featured in the new expansion.

Dive into all the fun of the #FF7R collaboration! 🙌✨ Beyond the Lifestream: Evercold 8-player raid series Keybound Brawler: Gold Saucer typing game There's a lot to look forward to alongside your adventures in Evercold! pic.twitter.com/5bFQe2GfUl

The game's director and producer Naoki Yoshida (also known as Yoshi-P) revealed at the Fan Festival event in Anaheim in April that "Evercold" will begin the series' new "Godless Realms" saga. Players will enter the Fourth, one of 13 reflections of the original Source world. He also teased various creatures including a "Wanderer," Arcane Giants, and a new race of cat creatures. The new expansion will also bring changes, including an updated Adventurer Activity user interface and a more weekly-based system as opposed to daily.

Square Enix released Final Fantasy XIV Online for personal computers in September 2010. After criticism from fans, the company revealed an updated version of the game titled Final Fantasy XIV: A Realm Reborn that added a new world and story. Final Fantasy XIV: A Realm Reborn launched on Windows PC and PlayStation 3 in August 2013, on PlayStation 4 in April 2014, on PlayStation 5 in May 2020, and on Xbox Series X|S in March 2024.

Square Enix has since released five expansions: "Heavensward" in June 2015, "Stormblood" in June 2017, "Shadowbringers" in July 2019, "Endwalker" in December 2021, and "Dawntrail" in July 2024. The game has recorded just under 35 million registered accounts worldwide as of April 24.

The game's mobile version for iOS and Android devices from Lightspeed Studios launched in China in June 2025, and had planned to have a global launch. However, Square Enix and Tencent announced earlier this month the game will end service in the Chinese mainland on September 30, with the global version seemingly canceled.

Square Enix announced in February 2022 that it will continue support for the MMORPG for the next 10 years.

Source: Final Fantasy XIV Fan Fest 2026 livestream

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV’s latest live letter gave us a detailed preview of the Beastmaster coming in September
Final Fantasy 14's Evercold expansion brings aboard a Final Fantasy 7 collab and a job that's all about fighting with massive shields
items.summary: And more, more, more, always more than that too.
items.content:
Image credit: Square Enix News by Oisin Kuhnke Contributor Published on July 25, 2026 3 comments Follow Final Fantasy XIV: A Realm Reborn - Collector's Edition Finally, a Final Fantasy 14 job made specifically for the type of person who likes to dual wield shields in Dark Souls ! The latest FF14 fan festival is taking place, and with that has come a suite of announcements, including a reveal at one of the two new jobs coming as part of the next expansion, Evercold.

We'll get back to in a moment because I know that someone would try to shoot me if I didn't first talk about the fact that a Final Fantasy 7 Remake themed raid series is also coming to the MMO. It's called Beyond the Lifestream, and it's being made in collaboration with the remakes' writer Kazushige Nojima (who's supervising the story), as well as the ever-mysterious Tetsuya Nomura (who's supervising the art design). Not much was actually revealed about it other than that it will have three full tier raids, and that there'll be outfits available themed around Barret and Tifa.

Right, that new job! It's called Bastion , and it's a main tank role paired with some twin shields. The role does start at level 90, so that's something to keep in mind for newcomers. The vibe really is a bit Soulsy at first glance, up until the role's moves get all magitek-like. That's it on details on the job for now, but plenty more was shown off at the fan festival. For starters there's the plethora of new places to visit, like the incredibly blue-looking city of Fargarth , there's also Naglfar, Realmship of Water , a big ole regal skyship, and Hringhorni, Realmship of Fire , another skyship in which we all must agree to not laugh at the second part of its name.

You can expect a few different system updates too. The team is experimenting with how quests play out, in that some main story quests will be playable in any order, though that won't affect how the story will play out. In tandem, to balance level progression there's a new feature called auto content balancing, which essentially sounds like level scaling catered. There'll be more character creator options like a colour picker for eyes, hair and skin tone, with more planned further down the line. And the new combat overhaul, Evolved, will also be coming, with a stream planned to take place at a later date detailing how it differs from the original system, Reborn (which you'll still be able to use).

There's a lot more than that too, so you can check out the broadcast to see all the finer details.

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV Fan Festival in Berlin reveals the new tank job, new areas, and a new FFVII raid
Final Fantasy 14 Has Finally Revealed Its New Tank Job
items.summary: Final Fantasy 14 has finally shown off its new tank job, and it's not quite what everyone expected.
items.content:
By Joshua Robertson Published Jul 25, 2026, 4:09 AM EDT Joshua Robertson is an editor for TheGamer, having working in news, guides, features, and reviews since 2022. They have written thousands of news stories, ranging from industry-breaking events, to smaller, more personal community pieces, and have covered several high-profile showcases such as The Game Awards and Nintendo Directs. Joshua is considered an expert in soulslikes, horror, JRPGs and everything Final Fantasy, having written extensive coverage for massively popular online titles like Final Fantasy 14. Sign in to your TheGamer account Add Us Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Final Fantasy 14 is undergoing some big changes when the next expansion, Evercold, launches next year . Not only will we be getting a complete combat overhaul, but director Yoshi-P has stated multiple times that certain systems we know will be dramatically altered to begin to respect player time a little more. It's all very exciting.

However, some things are staying the same, such as Final Fantasy 14 getting two new jobs to play upon the release of Evercold, a physical ranged job, and a tank job. We still don't know what the physical ranged job is going to be, but as promised back during the game's North American Fan Fest , we finally got our first look at the tank job.

Of course, we got the first tease about this tank job back during North America's Fan Fest, with a classic Yoshi-P shirt hint that revealed the character Rhitahtyn Sas Arvina, one of the main baddies in A Realm Reborn that uses two large shields with cannons equipped as his weapon of choice. That led many to believe the shirt hint was quite literal, and the tank job would be Gunshield or something similar, but we finally got confirmation from Yoshi-P during Berlin's Fan Fest.

Final Fantasy 14 has seen a sudden rush of players, probably down to the hype surrounding the next expansion, Evercold.

Shown off at the show's keynote in an updated trailer for Evercold, it was revealed that the new tank job will indeed have Gunshields. Unfortunately, it does appear to be the weapon of choice for an original character rather than an existing Scion, but it's still very cool to see weapons first introduced so long ago finally become usable.

As for how the job plays, we know it will be a Main tank job, as it was outlined at the previous Fan Fest that the tank roles are being split up more notably between Main and Off tanks (my condolences once again, Warriors), so we know it will be skilled at taking damage and countering the damage that enemies dish out.

As for what the role is called, its official title is Bastion, and it will wield the Skyltborg weapons. From the trailer, we can see that it deploys a range of physical and ranged attacks, while Yoshi-P has explained that it also comes equipped with a range of defensive spells for party members, reducing the amount of damage they take.

items.title: Final Fantasy XIV Mobile to end service on September 30 in China, global version canceled
items.summary: LightSpeed Studios will end service on the Chinese version of Final Fantasy XIV Mobile for iOS and Android on September 30, the company announced. The global version is no longer in development.
items.content:
Sal Romano Jul 17 2026 / 6:00 AM EDT 0 LightSpeed Studios will end service on the Chinese version of Final Fantasy XIV Mobile for iOS and Android on September 30, the company announced. The global version is no longer in development.

Final Fantasy XIV Mobile launched in China on June 19, 2025. A global release was planned to follow.

Here is the full termination of service announcement :

Thank you for your support for Final Fantasy XIV Mobile (Chinese Edition) as always.

On the launch day of Final Fantasy XIV Mobile (Chinese Edition) in the Chinese mainland, we said, “Resonate with the Light, and blaze as one,” and promised that the adventure had just begun. Over this time, it is you who have truly brought “ Mobile Eorzea” to life. Every suggestion you shared on gameplay, experiences, and features guided us to build the game world. Seasoned Warriors of Light stepped up as mentors, walking newcomers through the confusion of their first steps into Eorzea. And countless mornings and nights spent fighting side by side came together to form the vast, warm community we once envisioned together. To have resonated with all of you adventurers on this journey has been the greatest fortune of this world we built together, and a memory we will always treasure.

Today, however, we must regretfully share an important announcement. Due to adjustments in business operations and changes in the market environment, Tencent and Square Enix have, through amicable negotiation, decided to terminate the licensing agreement for Final Fantasy XIV Mobile (Chinese Edition). We are sorry to announce that we will officially stop the game operation for Final Fantasy XIV Mobile (Chinese Edition) in the Chinese mainland at 11:00 (UTC+8) on September 30, 2026.

To everyone who has journeyed with us until now, we sincerely apologize that we must end this service without being able to fully live up to your expectations. At the same time, we wish to express our heartfelt gratitude to all of you who have supported us along the way. Thank you, truly, from the bottom of our hearts. To everyone who has been looking forward to the global version, we also offer our sincere apologies for being unable to meet your expectations.

Except as otherwise required by laws and regulations, or otherwise agreed in the agreement between Tencent and users, we will delete the account data, character information, and other related data of players who registered and played in the Chinese mainland, in accordance with the Personal Information Protection Law after the game servers are shut down.

There are 76 days remaining until the service ends. To accompany everyone through this final journey in Final Fantasy XIV Mobile (Chinese Edition), our team will do our best. Thank you again for your support.

Final Fantasy XIV Mobile (Chinese Edition) Operations Team

items.summary: In the hope that would-be adventurers can experience all that FFXIV has to offer, we are pleased to announce the latest Free Login Campaign. Follow the Trail to the Heavens ! In Patch 7.5, you can face Enuo in the Unmaking, take a stroll th
items.content:
In the hope that would-be adventurers can experience all that FFXIV has to offer, we are pleased to announce the latest Free Login Campaign. Follow the Trail to the Heavens! In Patch 7.5, you can face Enuo in the Unmaking, take a stroll through Windurst: The Third Walk in the FINAL FANTASY XI alliance raid crossover, and leap into battle in Archeia Harmonias, an all-new arena for Crystalline Conflict. A host of other additions and adjustments will make your time in Eorzea more streamlined and enjoyable, including increased furnishing placement limits, the consolidation of dyes, and additional pieces of gear that can now be converted to outfit glamour or stored in the armoire. With the introduction of Patch 7.5, the Shadowbringers expansion can now be played as part of the FINAL FANTASY XIV Starter Edition. The expansion will be automatically registered to your account if you already own the Starter Edition, so why not take this opportunity to jump into the adventure?

If you or any of your friends are currently taking a break from your adventures, you won't want to miss out on this limited-time event! Visit the Free Login Campaign website for details.

items.content:
Experience the intriguing tale bridging Hydaelyn and Vana'diel as The Maiden's Rhapsody─a past collaboration with FFXI─returns to the realm once more! Embark on a journey with one of Vana'diel's heroes and discover what twists of fate brought her to our realm. * This event is identical to the one previously held. * If you have already completed the event, you can replay the quests via the seasonal event replay feature. We highly recommend learning more about this feature on the collaboration special site.

Event Duration

From Friday, May 8, 2026 at 1:00 a.m. (PDT) / 8:00 (GMT) / 9:00 (BST) / 18:00 (AEST) to Monday, May 25, 2026 at 7:59 a.m. (PDT) / 14:59 (GMT) / 15:59 (BST) / Tuesday, 26 May at 00:59 (AEST)

How to Participate

Begin the quest "A Journey to Remember" by speaking to the Remumu in Limsa Lominsa - Upper Decks (X:11.6 Y:11.2).

Rewards

Visit the special site for more details.

items.content: Beginning Tuesday, April 28, with the release of Patch 7.5, the free trial will also include the award-winning FINAL FANTASY XIV: Shadowbringers. Spread the word and tell your friends, because there’s never been a better time to begin their adventure! Check out the free trial. For those who have already registered FINAL FANTASY XIV: A Realm Reborn to their accounts, worry not─this change also applies to all existing owners as well. * Service accounts will be updated to reflect this change starting on Tuesday, April 28. Please note that the registration status update may not be displayed immediately on the Mog Station.
